newsitem.title: USA: MHC extends Chateau tender offer.
newsitem.headline: MHC extends Chateau tender offer.

text.p: Manufactured Home Communities Inc said Wednesday it extended its cash tender offer of $26 per share for Chateau Properties Inc stock, extending the deadline until midnight EDT October 23.

MHC said as of Tuesday, the previous deadline, about 2.995 million shares had been tendered. Including the shares owned by MHC, the company said it now has about 51 percent of Chateau's outstanding common shares, based on the most recent public information.

Chateau's and ROC Communities Inc's boards of directors both approved a revised merger of the companies last month. The mobile home park operators had initially signed a definitive agreement to merge in July.
Chateau last month rejected an unsolicited acquisition offer made by MHC, then urged its shareholders not to take MHC's tender offer.
MHC repeated in a statement it believes its $26 per share offer is superior to the Chateau/ROC stock merger.
Under the ROC and Chateau agreement, Chateau stockholders receive 1.0316 shares of the resulting combined company.
